# EfficientRepresentationalBudget

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The optimal allocation of representational capacity (e.g., number of distinct neural states) given a fixed structural budget of connections and nodes in a neuromorphic substrate. Guides design of iNEST systems to maximize information density and task performance under the hard constraints of in-network neuromorphic hardware.
